text: The reflection pass runs weekly and correlates signals across health, workshop, code and civic data.
Observations are append-only and never edited; the record of what happened is not revisable.
Conclusions are versioned and supersedable, and only currently active ones are embedded.
The interest scout scans YouTube, news and feeds nightly against a local model of what Steve finds interesting.
Wake detection listens for the phrase Hey Dami, pronounced DAH-mee, before recording an utterance.
Scale model kits need primer before airbrushing acrylic paint, and the fuselage halves cure overnight.
The pushback ledger records every challenge Dami makes, whether Steve accepted it, and what followed.
A system that tunes on reactions learns that challenge produces negative reactions, so the auditor decays.
The media librarian proposes file moves and tags but executes nothing until a human approves the manifest.
Personal photos, the conclusions ledger and health data never leave the host; only queries cross the boundary.
Reranking retrieves fifty candidates by cosine distance then reorders them to eight with a cross-encoder.
Frames carry a protocol version, message type, sequence number, correlation id and flags before the payload.
Proactive output is scarce by design; most passes produce conclusions and no surfacings at all.
Native C# plugins are the privileged tier because MCP is an egress surface with a process boundary.
Postgres with pgvector replaced Weaviate so embeddings can be joined transactionally against domain rows.
